question: Which candidates in an active process have a non-compete of six months or more, grouped by client?
sql: SELECT cl.name AS client_name, c.name AS candidate_name, r.title AS role_title, a.stage AS stage, c.current_employer AS current_employer, c.non_compete_months AS non_compete_months, c.notice_weeks AS notice_weeks FROM applications a JOIN candidates c ON c.id = a.candidate_id JOIN roles r ON r.id = a.role_id JOIN clients cl ON cl.id = r.client_id WHERE a.status = 'active' AND c.non_compete_months >= 6 ORDER BY cl.name, c.non_compete_months DESC, c.name LIMIT 200
answer: Seven candidates in active processes have a non-compete of six months or more. At Brackenvane Trading they are Ewan Fairley (12 months), Chloe Adeyemi (6) and Grace Holloway (6). At Fernhallow Capital they are Mei Lin Tan, Rohan Mehta, Ruth Abernethy and Wei Zhang (all 6).

meta.note: Active applications (status = 'active') for candidates with non_compete_months >= 6, listed per client with role and stage; one row per application.
